final: WITH funding_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc AS q JOIN projects AS p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, qc_count, qc_count * 1.0 / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, qc_count * 1.0 / AVG(qc_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM funding_counts
